goal: See that only the FIRST true condition in a chain of if/elif/else runs, even if later conditions are also true.
brief: A vertical flow of if/elif/else blocks checking a score variable. A slider sets the score from 0 to 100. As it moves, each condition box lights up green (checked), and exactly one branch lights up gold (the one that actually runs) while the rest stay gray.

controls.label: Score
controls.effect: Changes the value being tested, which changes which condition is true first and therefore which branch highlights gold.

try_this: Set Score to 95 and see which branch lights up gold.
Set Score to 72 and notice it skips the first condition.
Set Score to 40 and see the else branch finally run.
